name: Should I power wash my deck myself or hire a professional?

mainEntity.name: Should I power wash my deck myself or hire a professional?

acceptedAnswer.text: While power washing can be effective, improper technique can damage deck boards. If you're inexperienced, hiring a professional deck maintenance service in areas like Oakland or Berkeley is recommended. Professionals have the right equipment, knowledge of appropriate pressure settings, and experience to safely and effectively clean your deck without causing harm, ensuring a better result.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider hiring a professional for power washing to avoid damaging your deck, especially if you lack experience with the equipment.
